# Blue Plane Stay

> Official page of Blue Plane Stay, an airplane-cabin themed entire rental unit (private flat, 46 m2) in Jung-gu, Seoul, near Dongdaemun Design Plaza (DDP) and Myeongdong. Sleeps up to 6: 2 bedrooms, 3 queen beds, 2 bathrooms, kitchen, washer and dryer, self check-in from 16:00, check-out by 11:00. 3-minute flat walk to Dongdaemun History and Culture Park Station (Lines 2, 4, 5), Exit 5; Airport Bus 6001 stop for the airport (Toegye-ro 6-ga, Gwanghui-dong Community Center) 1 minute away, arrival stop (Baiton Hotel) 5 minutes. 3rd floor of a newly built building, no elevator. Registered hostel business with Jung-gu Office, Seoul.
